_comment: Hub cities. Every municipality (NL) / arrondissement (BE) / district (DE, LU) / canton (CH) / province (TR) joins the hub you reach fastest by road in the same country. 'points' are where travel times are measured from (two for twin-city regions). 'new' holds the metadata used to create a region file the first time. 'name' and 'subtitle' label regions that have no quests yet.
_targets: Quest target per region: 60 + 35 per million inhabitants above the first million, plus 'visit' (tourism bonus: 100 for Paris, 50 for major international destinations, 25 for other well-visited regions), kept between 60 and 300. See tools/targets.py.

_overrides._why: Units whose fastest hub by a few minutes is not where people would naturally start from.
